findings.claim: Winners make most of their kills late: 2.51 kills per winner-game after 120 s vs 0.68 in the first 60 s, and 58% of winners' kills after 120 s are laser kills (93 complete showdowns).
findings.suggested_change: Rank mid/late laser-kill mechanisms above opening changes
findings.mechanism: Score tracks our kills; the largest kill pool is after 120 s and is mostly laser kills

findings.claim: Our laser lets go only at full charge (fire[laser] = !(full && lined)); a top-16 public bot releases a partial charge early when 0.8 x its partial damage already covers the target's HP.

sources.ref: Watcher T06 public MIT bot, mech/brain.go:978-990 (commit f3871e2; link withheld per team rule)

sources.quote: Damage scales with the charge, from min_frac 35% at none to damage 315 at full

findings.suggested_change: LETHAL_RELEASE flag: release a charging laser once 0.8 x partial damage (with cube bonus and cook-off) >= locked target's visible hp and lined up, never before min_charge
findings.mechanism: Finishes low targets up to 0.6 s sooner, before they break line of sight; touches only late laser kills

findings.claim: In 1,856 showdown first engagements, landing the first hit gives KILL 309 / DIED 171 vs KILL 129 / DIED 297 when the opponent lands it; rear hits are 9.2% of hits dealt in KILL engagements vs 1.3% in DIED ones.

sources.quote: first hit mine: n=993 KILL=309 DIED=171; first hit theirs: n=863 KILL=129 DIED=297
A hit from outside your torso's front arc ... deals mech.rear_mult (x1.5) damage

findings.suggested_change: UNSEEN_PICK flag: target.ts bonus for an enemy whose aim is >90 deg off its bearing to us and >45 m away
findings.mechanism: A target that cannot see us gives us the first hit and x1.5 rear damage

findings.claim: A top-16 bot's fitted fight-odds model adds +0.82 logit when opening on a target whose aim is more than 1.75 rad off us, alongside log HP ratio, capped cube difference, weapon count and busy terms.

sources.ref: Watcher T06 public MIT bot, mech/brain.go:1890-1924 (commit f3871e2; link withheld per team rule)

findings.suggested_change: Use the aim-off-us signal as one target-pick term (see UNSEEN_PICK); ideas only, no code reuse

findings.claim: Showdown winners almost always end up with a laser (94% vs 34% of the bottom half), but laser by 30 s is only 57% vs 33%; 30 of winners' 45 first lasers taken after 30 s were dropped weapons, and 862 lasers were dropped on the tick their holder died.
findings.suggested_change: Step A: count sim games where we kill a laser holder and end without a laser; build TAKE_KILL_LASER only if >=10/192
findings.mechanism: In practice only house bots we kill drop lasers; taking it converts a kill into the late laser that finishes most late kills

findings.claim: The early-laser lever looks saturated on the site: B17 arm-up gained +0.42, but UF100 raised sim laser-by-30 s 58 -> 82 of 192 and tied 3.79, and every later early-laser variant tied or lost.

sources.ref: coord/data/site_results.csv (B17, UF100, B36, B74, B40, B32, B39, B64, B45 rows)

findings.suggested_change: Do not spend slots on opening or early-laser changes

findings.claim: B21's upgrade reorder (sensors moved below weapon upgrades) lost 0.04 on deterministic seeds; sensors adds +25 m vision and +15 m proximity, which plausibly buys the first hit that decides first fights.
findings.suggested_change: Keep sensors at rank 3; if an empty slot appears, order only the weapon tier (gun_mag first) and leave sensors in place

findings.claim: Opening on an opponent already under 70% HP gives KILL 111 / DIED 16 (n=244) in showdown first engagements; winners open on hurt targets 25% of the time vs 8% for the bottom half.

sources.quote: opp already <70% HP: n=244 KILL=111 DIED=16

findings.suggested_change: No new build: target pick already weights hp (TARGET_W.hp); keep as evidence for target-pick tuning
